snippet.title: RESIDENT EVIL OPENBOR - Download!
snippet.description:
Game created by ChrisMonvel
DOWNLOAD at:
https://chrismonvel.wixsite.com/chrismonvel/resident-evil-survive-summary
Would the Resident Evil franchise work as a Beatnup? Here we have a demo of a very promising fan game, great sprites and showing that with some adjustments and balancing it can be a very fun experience.
